insights_signals.summary: Following your dividend receipt, we recommend reviewing your tax relief strategies before the 31 December deadline. Maximizing your SRS (Supplementary Retirement Scheme) and CPF Cash Top-ups can provide immediate tax relief while enhancing your long-term retirement planning.

Assess CPF Cash Top-up for you or your spouse for additional tax relief
Explore SRS-approved investment strategies to optimize returns on idle SRS balances
Review whether dividend funds should be deployed via the UBS Variable Capital Company (VCC) structure if established
